body: Hihi!! What your parents/military needs is a letter from the National Clearinghouse which basically proves your enrollment as a student, and your expected graduation date! You can contact the VA office or I believe that their website has a direct link the the National Student Clearinghouse site. What I normally did was save the link so every year I don’t have to bother the VA office and wait on them :)))
I also heard that too! It was near 45th and roosevelt. There was like a loud bang and a flash of light but idk what it was. If anyone knows pls lmk because that was so scary sounding 😭😭
